intro: Here is a museum with a twist. You are at Side Museum, a museum in Antalya province, opened in 1962. The building is the Roman bath of Side, repaired after excavation and turned into the museum. So the sculpture from the agora and theatre now stands in the very rooms where the city washed.
history: The Roman agora baths of Side were repaired in the early 1960s and turned into the museum, which opened in 1962. Sculpture from the city's agora, theatre and temples stands in the bath halls. Step outside into the courtyard: it is a stone garden of sarcophagi and inscriptions.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the Bath halls and the Sculpture collection, then the Sarcophagi and the Open-air stone garden.
facts: Did you know? Side was the slave-trading centre of Pamphylia; Strabo writes that pirates auctioned their captives in its harbour. And the museum is the city's Roman bath, so the sculpture stands in the rooms where Side once washed.
outro: This brings our tour of Side Museum to an end. Before you go, please leave the objects untouched and take your photographs without flash. Thank you for your company, and enjoy your visit.
